name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Acrylic And Wooden LED Night Light
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from a unique 2-layer structure combining acrylic and wood, creating a beautiful, dimensional decorative effect.
               → Layer 1: High-quality acrylic, 3mm thickness.
               → Layer 2: Plywood, 3mm thickness.
    - The acrylic and wooden layers are precision laser-cut and assembled, ensuring a smooth finish and high durability.
    - Comes with a solid wooden LED base that securely holds the plaque upright for a stable tabletop display.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in 2 sizes:
               +) 5.9 × 5.9 in ~ 15 × 15 cm  → Wooden LED base: 15 x 4 x 3 cm ~ 5.9 x 1.57 x 1.18 in.
               +) 7.87 × 7.87 in ~ 20 × 20 cm → Wooden LED base: 20 x 4 x 3 cm ~ 7.87 x 1.57 x 1.18 in.
    - Each acrylic panel is custom-shaped according to the design and perfectly fits the LED wooden base.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
               +) Layer 1 (Acrylic): Supports single-sided or double-sided printing.
               +) Layer 2 (Wooden layer): Supports single-sided printing.
    - The printing process ensures long-lasting color quality and resistance to fading.
    - The layered structure creates a beautiful 3D visual effect when the LED light is turned on.
     
  • Lighting Options:
    - Equipped with a built-in LED wooden base that provides soft and energy-efficient lighting.
    - Available with single-color light or multi-color LED options to suit different decorative preferences.
    - The gentle LED glow highlights the artwork while creating a warm and relaxing atmosphere.
    - Powered via USB connection, making it convenient for everyday use.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a custom decorative LED night light that showcases personalized artwork, names, or meaningful messages.
    - Perfect for placing on desks, bedside tables, shelves, or office décor spaces.
    - The acrylic and wooden layered design creates a distinctive illuminated display both day and night.
    - Ideal as home décor, bedroom lighting, or personalized keepsake display.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful gift for family members, friends, or loved ones.
    - Perfect for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, Christmas, or housewarming celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who appreciates personalized décor and sentimental keepsakes.
    - Combines modern lighting with natural wooden aesthetics, making it a memorable decorative gift. 🎁

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape 2-Layer Acrylic And Wooden LED Night Light 

 

PRODUCTION

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
